name: Acrylic Message Lamp
description:
KEY FEATURES:

  • Best Material: Made of acrylic and the wooden base
  • The Multi-functional of the acrylic message lamp includes:

 

  •  Personalized Messages: The primary function of an acrylic message lamp is to display personalized messages, quotes, or phrases. Users can customize the message, font, and color to create a unique ambiance or convey a specific sentiment.
  • Mood Lighting: Acrylic message lamps often come with adjustable lighting settings, allowing users to choose different colors and brightness levels. This makes them suitable for creating mood lighting in various settings, from romantic dinners to calming bedtime routines.
  • Decoration: These lamps can act as decorative pieces in homes, offices, or events. They can be used to complement interior decor, add a touch of elegance, or serve as a focal point in a room.
  • Night Light: Some acrylic message lamps are designed to function as night lights. They emit a soft and soothing glow, making them ideal for children's bedrooms or as guiding lights in dark hallways.
  • Memorabilia Display: Users can insert meaningful photos or artwork into the lamp to create a personalized display. This can be a way to showcase cherished memories or artwork in an eye-catching manner.
  • Special Occasions: Acrylic message lamps are often used to celebrate special occasions such as birthdays, anniversaries, or weddings. They can display congratulatory messages, names of the couple, or event details.
  • Desk Lamp: Smaller acrylic message lamps can function as desk lamps. They provide both illumination and a customizable display area, making them suitable for workspaces.

 

  • Customization: The design will be printed on a wooden base by our UV-printed technology. This product includes a box of colored markers, so you can easily design your own artwork.
  • Gift of love: A perfect idea if you are looking for a birthday gift, a Mother’s Day/ Father’s Day/ Christmas gift for your family or friends. You can gift it to your favorite celebrities, friends, family members, and lovers.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Message Lamp

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
